core_obligations: A CLT does not identify the second derivative of the asymptotic log-Laplace transform. The authors reduce to a Busemann martingale, construct an exponential submartingale transform for unbounded differences and combine quadratic-variation large deviations with a separate upper concentration bound to identify both sides with the CLT variance.
